description: Get the facts of one Dutch home: address, size, building, its current listings with links to every source website (where to apply, rent or buy), a listing-history summary, and the energy label registered in EP-Online (RVO). Pass property_slug from search_listings or resolve_place, or listing_id for a listing without a property page.

language.description: Language of huisly.nl links and of area-figure labels: en (default) or nl
